label: Overlapping and non-overlapping implication
subgoals: Mark every cycle where the antecedent is 1 as an attempt
Check the consequent in the same cycle for |-> and the next cycle for |=>
Count the failures and set aside attempts still pending at the end

label: Fixed delays
subgoals: Shift each attempt's check by the fixed delay
Read the consequent at the shifted cycle
Count failures and mark attempts whose check falls beyond the trace as pending

label: Delay ranges
subgoals: Open a window from m to n cycles after each attempt
Pass the attempt at the first cycle in the window where the consequent holds
Fail it only when the full window lies within the trace and has no match
